$comment: DonutSMP /sell base prices, per item, at a 1.0x multiplier.
This is the file to edit. craftflip reloads it whenever it changes, so values
read in game with /worth can be added without a rebuild. Two files are read and
merged: the copy shipped in the image (this one) and, if it exists, a copy at
$DATA_DIR/sell_prices.json -- the mounted volume -- whose entries win. Add your
own values to the volume copy so a redeploy cannot overwrite them.
An entry is either a bare number, or an object:
"mult" is your own /sellmulti level for that item (1.0x-3.0x, per item). It
defaults to the top-level "multiplier" below. "source" is one of in-game, wiki
or community, and it feeds the confidence score: a value you read yourself with
/worth is trusted, a community value less so.
Nothing here is inferred. A base price the server does not publish cannot be
guessed from the shop -- /shop prices are what the server CHARGES, which is a
different number from what /sell pays. Items absent from this table simply have
no fixed sell price, and the ledger falls back to what the item has actually

dried_kelp_block.note: a community quant project lists 300 for this item; the wiki's 550 is used here
